pages.text: Writes a message to the chat.$(br2)The message starts with the program name and PID. With $(1)player$(), only that player gets it; if they are not online, INVALID_ARGUMENT is raised. Otherwise all players near the trigger block get it (64 blocks by default).
$(li)$(1)message$() STRING: the message$(li)$(1)player$() STRING: the name of one player (optional, default empty for all players nearby)
$(1)CALL c0de/minecraft/SAY$(br)  PARAMETER message "The farm is full!" ;$(br)  PARAMETER player "Alex" ;$()
